question_text: What is the vision of USTP?
answer_content: USTP's vision is to be a nationally recognized Science and Technology University providing the vital link between education and the economy.

question_text: What is the mission of USTP?
answer_content: USTP's mission is to: (1) bring the world of work (industry) into the actual higher education and training of students; (2) offer entrepreneurs the opportunity to maximize their business potential, from product conceptualization to commercialization; and (3) contribute significantly to the national development goals of food security and energy sufficiency through technological solutions.

question_text: What are the core values of USTP?
answer_content: USTP's core values are Unselfish Dedication, Social Responsiveness, Transformational Leadership, and Prudence.

question_text: What are the USTP graduate attributes?
answer_content: USTP graduates are expected to show Innovative Thinking, Critical Thinking, Resilience, Empathy, Teamwork and Collaboration, and Communication Skills.

question_text: When was USTP founded?
answer_content: USTP was established on August 16, 2016, by Republic Act 10919, which merged the Mindanao University of Science and Technology (MUST) in Cagayan de Oro and the Misamis Oriental State College of Agriculture and Technology (MOSCAT) in Claveria.

question_text: What are the campuses of USTP?
answer_content: USTP has eight campuses: Alubijid (the main campus), Cagayan de Oro, Claveria, Villanueva, Balubal, Jasaan, Oroquieta and Panaon.

question_text: Where is USTP Cagayan de Oro?
answer_content: USTP Cagayan de Oro is on Claro M. Recto Avenue, Lapasan, Cagayan de Oro City 9000.

question_text: What is the contact number of USTP CDO?
answer_content: You can call USTP Cagayan de Oro at (088) 856-1738. Its Facebook page is facebook.com/USTPcagayan.

question_text: What colleges are at USTP CDO?
answer_content: USTP Cagayan de Oro has the College of Engineering and Architecture, College of Information Technology and Computing, College of Science and Mathematics, College of Science and Technology Education, College of Technology, College of Medicine, College of Nursing, and the Senior High School.

question_text: What online portals do USTP students use?
answer_content: PRISMS (prisms.ustp.edu.ph) for student records and applications, USTeP (ustep.ustp.edu.ph), eClearance (clearance.ustp.edu.ph), and the USTP Helpdesk (ustp.edu.ph/helpdesk).

question_text: What does the USTP logo mean?
answer_content: The USTP logo shows atomic particles forming a stylized map of Mindanao with weaving patterns.

question_text: Is USTP ISO certified?
answer_content: Yes. USTP is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

Graduate: Master of Engineering, MS Electrical Engineering, MS Sustainable Development (Urban Planning and Sustainable Development), Professional Science Masters in Power Systems Engineering and Management, and PhD in Energy Engineering.

question_text: What are the requirements to enter the USTP College of Medicine?
answer_content: Per the college page: a Filipino citizen aged 20 to 35, a bachelor's degree earned within the last five years, an NMAT score in the 80th percentile or higher (taken within 2 years), a GWA of 85% or better in English, Mathematics, Chemistry, Zoology and Social Science, and a passed panel interview. Selection: NMAT 40%, GWA 40%, interview 20%.

question_text: What scholarships does USTP itself offer?
answer_content: USTP's own scholarships are Entrance Scholarships, Academic Excellence, Leadership Scholarship, Grant-in-Aid for Minority, ARCU Scholarship, Athletic Scholarship, and NSTP-ROTC Scholarship. Ask the Admission and Scholarship Office for the requirements.

question_text: What outside scholarships can USTP students apply for?
answer_content: Grants: CHED Grant-in-Aid, CEPALCO Educational Assistance, ICTSI, NAPOLCOM, FAST Cooperative, NCIP, GSIS, and PESFA. Merit scholarships: CEPALCO, CHED, Del Monte Foundation, DBP RISE, DOST-SEI, PLDT-SMART Foundation, City Scholars, Lifebank Foundation, NGCP, Yokohama Tire, Rebisco Foundation, SM Foundation, and Philippine Sinter Corporation Foundation.

question_text: What recognitions does USTP have?
answer_content: USTP is a CHED Center of Excellence in Information Technology (the only one in Mindanao) and a Center of Development in Mathematics, Electrical Engineering and Agriculture. It has a QS 3-Star rating, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and Level IV state university status.

question_text: What was USTP CDO called before?
answer_content: Before 2016, the Cagayan de Oro campus was the Mindanao University of Science and Technology (MUST). USTP was formed in 2016 by merging MUST with MOSCAT in Claveria.
